title: Global Mobility Strategy Checklist
subtitle: How to Plan, Apply, and Succeed in an International Career Move

sections.title: Why Global Careers Are on the Rise

blocks.text: In today’s interconnected economy, international careers are no longer optional—they’re strategic. Whether it’s consulting in London, tech in Silicon Valley, or finance in Dubai, global experience is seen as a **differentiator for leadership roles.**
Employers value professionals with international exposure because they bring:
Remote work is now common, but in-person **global rotations, transfers, and relocations** remain a fast track to senior leadership.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Write down 3 countries where you’d like to work. Circle the one that aligns best with your career goals.
Why should you consider moving abroad for work?

items: **Career Growth:** International assignments are linked with faster promotions.
**Financial Benefits:** Salaries in the US, UK, and Middle East often outpace home-country packages.
**Skill Development:** Exposure to global markets strengthens leadership and problem-solving skills.
**Personal Growth:** Living abroad builds resilience, adaptability, and cultural awareness.

blocks.label: Reflection
blocks.text: Beyond salary, which benefit excites you most about a global role?

sections.title: Choosing the Right Country for Your Career

blocks.text: Not every country suits every professional. You must balance opportunity, visa ease, and lifestyle.

items: **US:** Great for tech, finance, consulting, but tough visas (H1B).
**UK:** Strong for consulting and finance; post-study work visas available.
**Middle East (UAE, KSA, Qatar):** High salaries, tax-free, booming in finance/consulting.
**Canada:** Easier PR pathways, but salaries lower than US.
**Singapore:** Asia hub for consulting, banking, supply chain.

blocks.label: Exercise
blocks.text: Research 1 target country and note its top hiring industries.
Visa rules vary widely. Examples:

items: **UK Skilled Worker Visa:** Points-based; requires employer license.
**Canada PR:** Express Entry based on age, education, experience.

blocks.label: Check before you plan
blocks.text: Visa and immigration rules change often. Confirm the current requirements on the official government website for each country.

blocks.label: Worksheet
blocks.text: Write down visa eligibility for your top country.

Rohit, a consultant in India, aimed for London. He rewrote his resume to UK standards, reached out to alumni there and secured interviews. He negotiated relocation support and a signing bonus, and moved within 6 months.

blocks.label: Lesson
blocks.text: Localization + networking = success.

sections.title: Finance Role in the Middle East

blocks.text: Aditi, an Indian CA, applied for Dubai-based IB firms. She emphasized transferable skills, built connections on LinkedIn, and used her CFA Level I certification to stand out. She landed an associate role with a tax-free salary well above her pay in India.

blocks.label: Lesson
blocks.text: Certifications + networking accelerate Middle East pivots.

items: Not building a global network early.
